title: Resume Session — should its popup match?

steps.headline: Should Resume Session use the matching popup header and list edge?
steps.risk: Actual popup crops show its list column; open the full two-column preview separately. The transcript and production styling are unchanged.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: 14px bold title, existing tapered divider, and painted 36px fade at the scrolling list edges.

variants.label: Matching
